Subject: Supplier identity census — request for legal entity details & PO contacts

Hi Luis / BrightArc team,

Hope you had a good end of year. We're getting BrightArc ready in Redwood's supplier registry so our procurement and AP teams can route POs and invoices correctly. To complete the record we need the following items from you: 

- Legal entity full name (exact as registered)
- Tax identification (TIN/EIN) or VAT number if applicable
- Registered/corporate address (street, city, state, zip, country)
- Primary PO contact name, role, and email (this person will receive purchase orders)
- Remittance contact (name + AP email for invoices)
- Bank routing details for ACH/Wire (bank name + account last 4; we will provide secure upload instructions)
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax doc if non-US

I've attached our short vendor onboarding form — if you can complete and return that plus any tax docs and bank info, we'll finish setup and confirm the default PO routing. Jordan (cc'd) will map the PO contact into our ERP once we have these.

Timeline: if you can return by Tuesday, Jan 5, we'll enable BrightArc for new POs the following week.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
